Shanghai Municipal Police

DIRECTOR OF CRIMINAL
INTELLIGENCE

Shanghai, October 13, 1927.

D. C. I.

According to the latest information, George
Hsu Chien (徐謙), a Communist member of the Wuhan Party,
is now in Hankow carrying on his activities secretly.

Hsu arrived in Shanghai from Hankow in the
beginning of September, 1927. While in Shanghai, he
stayed for a few days at rooms 25 and 35 of the Burlington
Hotel, and then left for Nanking with a view to participating
in the conference in Nanking which took place on September
15, 1927. Having met with a cool reception from the
other members of the conference, Hsu left Nanking for
Kiukiang before the inauguration of the new Nanking
Government. In Kiukiang he joined Waung Ching Wei (汪精衛),
the leader of the Wuhan Party, and went with him to Hankow
about the end of September.

Hsu Chien's family arrived in Shanghai from Hankow on
September 15 and are still living, it is believed, at No. 34
Route Dofffus, French Town.

A look-out is being kept for the return of
George Hsu Chien to Shanghai and efforts will be made to
arrest him when he comes back. I recommend that the
attached warrant be filed in the meantime.

File the
warrant until
the gentleman
wanted turns up
A.C.P.
13.X.27

Instructions by A.C.P.
Given to this
warrant. W.S.K.

上海，1927年10月13日。

刑事情报处处长（D. C. I.）

据最新消息，武汉国民党共产党成员徐謙（George Hsu Chien）目前身在汉口，秘密开展活动。

徐氏于1927年9月初从汉口抵达上海。在上海期间，他在百老汇大厦（Burlington Hotel）的25号和35号房间停留数日，随后前往南京，意图参加1927年9月15日在南京举行的会议。由于在会议上受到其他成员的冷遇，徐氏在新南京政府成立前离开南京前往九江。在九江，他加入了武汉国民党领袖汪精衛（Waung Ching Wei），并于9月底左右随其前往汉口。

徐謙的家属于9月15日从汉口抵达上海，据信目前仍居住在法租界杜美路（Route Dofffus）34号。

警方正密切监视乔治·徐謙（George Hsu Chien）返回上海的行踪，并将在其回来时设法将其逮捕。我建议在此期间将附带的逮捕令归档保存。

助理警务处长（A.C.P.）批示：
将该逮捕令归档，
直至被通缉者出现
1927年10月13日

助理警务处长（A.C.P.）指令：
已对该逮捕令
作出指示。W.S.K.
1927年10月14日

May 24, 27.

Dear Colonel,

I return herewith your papers relative to
George Hsu Hsien and Teng Yi Ta, two Chinese Communists
reported to be en route from Hankow to Holland, and forward
at the same time a Police Report, dated May 24, giving an

with a view to locating them. These inquiries will be
continued in co-operation with the Chinese Authorities, and

Shanghai Municipal Police.

Intelligence Office C.I.D. Station.
May 24 1927.

REPORT ON Whereabouts of George Hsu Chien and Teng Yi Ta.

Made by C.D.I. Givens Forwarded by

Sir,

Despite careful inquiries, no confirmation can be found of the report that George Hsu Chien (徐謙) and Teng Yi Ta (鄧演達) have left Hankow with the intention of proceeding to Holland on a Japanese ship. On the other hand all the information obtained in the course of the investigations tends to show that both these men are still at Hankow. The Nationalist Government at Nanking has given orders that in case either George Hsu Chien or Teng Yi Ta are arrested, they are to be summarily executed, and the fate which will overtake them if they fall into the hands of Marshal Chang Tso Ling's forces, will, if anything, be worse. Hence it is extremely unlikely that George Hsu Chien or Teng Yi Ta will venture into the territory of either General Chiang Kai Shek or Marshal Chang Tso Ling. The hostile attitude of Japan towards the Chinese Communist Party would moreover be likely to deter them from using a Japanese ship.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

[Signature]
C. D. I.

May 20 1927.

REPORT ON Chinese who are proceeding from Hankow to Holland by
a Japanese Steamer.

Made by C. D. I. Givens Forwarded by

Sir,
There is a good reason to believe that Teng Yi Ta
(鄧演達) and Sin K'ien( - ), who are reported to be en route
from Hankow to Holland by a Japanese steamer, are really Teng
Yi Ta(鄧演達) and Dr. George Hsu Chien(徐謙) alias Hsu Chi Lung
(徐季龍), whose photographs are attached herewith.
Teng Yi Ta(鄧演達), who is a noted Communist, age
about 30, is a native of Kwangtung. Introduced into the Kuoming-
tang Party some three years ago by Wang Ching Wei(汪精衛),
he quickly advanced to a position of influence, and is now one
of the most prominent leaders of the Left Wing of that party.
He at present is Minister of Agriculture in the Wuhan Government
and a member of the Military Commission which controls the army
under its control. He was very friendly with General Chiang
Kai Shek up to the time of the split. Since then Teng and Chiang
are deadly enemies.
Dr. George Hsu Chien(徐謙) alias Hsu Chi Lung
(徐季龍), one of the leaders of the Chinese Communist Party,
was born in Anhwei in 1872. In his early years he studied in Peking
until he attained the Han-Lin degree and then studied Foreign Law
for three years in a law college in Peking called "Chin Szi Kwan".
In 1907 Dr. Hsu was appointed Attorney-General of the Higher
Court in Peking and in 1910 he was China's delegate to the
International Prison Conference held in Washington. After the
overthrow of the Chin dynasty in 1912, Dr. Hsu became Vice
Minister of Justice. He remained in this position for only half
a year when he resigned owing to differences with President Yuan

先生，
有充分理由相信，据报道正乘日本轮船从汉口前往荷兰的 Teng Yi Ta（鄧演達）和 Sin K'ien（ - ），实为邓演达（鄧演達）和乔治·徐謙博士（徐謙）（又名徐季龍 Hsu Chi Lung），其照片附后。
邓演达（鄧演達），著名共产党员，年龄约30岁，广东人。约三年前由汪精衛（Wang Ching Wei）引入国民党，迅速晋升至具有影响力的地位，现为该党左派最杰出的领导人之一。他目前担任武汉政府农业部长，也是控制其麾下军队的军事委员会成员。在分裂之前，他与蒋介石将军关系非常友好。此后，邓与蒋成为死敌。
乔治·徐謙博士（徐謙）（又名徐季龍 Hsu Chi Lung），中国共产党领导人之一，1872年生于安徽。早年在北京求学，直至获得翰林学位，随后在北京一所名为“京师法政学堂”（Chin Szi Kwan）的法学院研习外国法律三年。
1907年，徐博士被任命为北京高等法院检察长，1910年作为中国代表参加在华盛顿举行的国际监狱会议。1912年清朝推翻后，徐博士出任司法部次长。他在此职位上仅任职半年，便因与袁总统意见不合而辞职

Shin Kai.    During the second revolution in 1913 Dr. Hsu
practised law in Shanghai before the Mixed Court and Chinese
Courts. He became a member of the Christian Church in Shanghai
in 1916. He was again Vice Minister of Justice in the first
Tuan Chi Jui Cabinet under President Li Yuan Hung and resigned
from that position as a protest against the dissolution of
Parliament by President Li. In 1917 Dr. Hsu was invited by
the late Dr. Sun Yat Sen to Canton as his Chief Secretary, and
was made Minister of Justice of the Canton Government in the
following year. When the Paris Peace Conference was called in
1919, Hsu was asked by the Canton Government to go as advisor to
the Chinese delegation, and also by the Chinese Christian
Churches to act as a representative of their interests at the
conference. Upon his return from the Paris Conference Hsu found
that the Canton Government had been overthrown by the Kwangsi
faction under General Lu Yung Ting. Hsu then went to Tientsin
where he became editor-in-chief of the Peking and Tientsin
editions of a Chinese newspaper entitled "Ih Shih Pao" or "The
Social Welfare". He resigned from that position in May 1920,
and took a position in the Southern Government in Canton where
he remained until 1922. He joined Marshal Feng Yu Hsiang(馮玉祥)
during the Chihli-Fengtien war in 1924. He instigated the
students' agitation in Peking on March 18, 1925 when a large
number of people were killed by the mob. Following this incident,
a warrant was issued for his arrest. Hsu was in Russia in 1926.
Upon returning to China with his wife Sun Yi Ping(沈儀彬), who

申凯（Shin Kai）。    1913年二次革命期间，徐博士
在上海混合法庭和中国法院从事律师工作。他于1916年加入上海基督教教会。在黎元洪总统任内的第一届段祺瑞内阁中，他再次出任司法部次长，并为抗议黎总统解散国会而辞去该职。1917年，徐博士应已故孙中山博士之邀前往广州担任其秘书长，并于次年出任广州政府司法部长。1919年召开巴黎和会时，广州政府请徐氏作为中国代表团顾问前往，中国基督教教会也请他作为其在和会上利益的代表。从巴黎和会回来后，徐氏发现广州政府已被陆荣廷将军领导的广西派系推翻。徐氏随后前往天津，成为中文报纸《益世报》（Ih Shih Pao）或《社会福利》（The Social Welfare）北京和天津版的主编。他于1920年5月辞去该职，并在广州南方政府任职，直至1922年。1924年直奉战争期间，他加入冯玉祥（Feng Yu Hsiang）元帅麾下。他煽动了1925年3月18日北京的学生骚乱，当时大量民众被暴徒杀害。在此事件之后，签发了对他的逮捕令。徐氏于1926年在俄罗斯。
1926年8月，他与妻子沈儀彬（Sun Yi Ping）一同从俄罗斯返回中国，

他于1926年8月居住在法租界杜美路（Route Dollfus）28号。他于1926年8月20日左右秘密前往广州。除了官方职务外，多年来他还担任位于法租界神父路（Rue Pere Robert）的上海法政学院（一所共产主义学校）的院长，该校最近被国民革命军查封。
1926年南方军队占领湖北后，徐博士被任命为汉口共产主义政府司法部长，同时当选为国民党中央执行委员会常务委员会委员。他是共产主义的坚定拥护者。

目前正努力获取有关邓和徐当前下落及未来计划的信息。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，

[签名]
C. D. I.
